referencePolicy: Historical sources remain applicable to retained IDs. Source-assisted vocabulary expansion adds CC-CEDICT-derived lexical edits, attributed Tatoeba/ManyThings contexts and project-authored AI-assisted contexts. Per-sentence attribution and retained source notes are bundled in source-index.json and displayed by Sources & licenses. Structural/linguistic editing does not certify rights or human review.
separation: Lexicon content derived from CC-CEDICT retains CC BY-SA 4.0. Stroke geometry retains the separate Arphic Public License. Independent app source code is not relicensed by these data notices.
